Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the ".in" top-level domain as Indonesia (it denotes India) and treated "Kota" as an Indonesian context, disregarding evidence from the search results (e.g., CBSE/iCBSE listings) that clearly place Bal Vidyalaya in Kota, Rajasthan, India. This premature, incorrect geographic inference led to an erroneous country attribution.
